content.short: SmartMuv is a platform for Solidity smart contract state analysis, storage extraction, and activity exploration.
content.description: SmartMuv provides a platform for Solidity smart contract state analysis, storage extraction, and activity exploration. It enables a complete view of a contract's storage layout, including variable names, values, and slot numbers. SmartMuv's Key Approximation Analysis addresses Solidity's limitations in mapping variable keys, improving the accuracy and breadth of state extraction. It is a valuable tool for developers, auditors, and blockchain explorers, supporting contract auditing, managing upgrades, migrating contracts between EVM-compatible chains, and enabling deeper exploration of Dapps.
